camel_example: aliyun cloudfw ListApplicationTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --CustomRuleStatus Enable --ApplicationTemplateIds.1 'ati-4f0691c56b8d4f06' --Description '办公网应用管控' --PageSize 10 --UnknownAction Alert --PageNo 1 --ApplicationTemplateName '应用程序模板' --BuiltInApplicationStatus Enable --TemplateStatus Enable --method POST --force
description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the list of application program templates under the current Alibaba Cloud account. Supports paging, fuzzy search by template name and description, batch exact filtering by template ID, and exact filtering by switch statuses and actions for unrecognized applications
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的应用程序模板列表。支持按模板名称和描述信息模糊搜索，按模板ID批量精确过滤，按各开关状态和未识别应用动作精确过滤
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw list-application-template --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --application-template-ids '["ati-4f0691c56b8d4f06"]' --application-template-name '应用程序模板' --description '办公网应用管控' --template-status Enable --built-in-application-status Enable --custom-rule-status Enable --unknown-action Alert --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplicationTemplate

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值需大于等于1，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of application template IDs for batch exact matching
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序模板ID列表，批量精确匹配
parameters.name: application_template_ids

parameters.help_en: The application template name for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序模板名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: application_template_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the application template for fuzzy matching
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序模板描述信息，模糊匹配
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The master switch status of the application template for exact matching. Valid values:
Enable: enabled
Disable: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
应用程序模板总开关状态，精确匹配。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭
parameters.name: template_status

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of built-in application control for exact matching. Valid values:
Enable: enabled
Disable: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内置应用管控开关状态，精确匹配。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭
parameters.name: built_in_application_status

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of custom application rules for exact matching. Valid values:
Enable: enabled
Disable: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
应用程序自定义规则开关状态，精确匹配。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭
parameters.name: custom_rule_status

parameters.help_en:
The action for unrecognized applications for exact matching. Valid values:
Allow: allow
Alert: monitor
Deny: block
parameters.help_zh:
未识别应用的处置动作，精确匹配。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
parameters.name: unknown_action

ApplicationTemplateName.description_en: The name of the application template

BuiltInApplicationActionStatistics.description_en: The statistics on the number of built-in applications in the template, categorized by the final effective action
BuiltInApplicationActionStatistics.description_zh: 模板内内置应用按最终生效动作分类的数量统计

AlertApplicationCount.description_en: The number of built-in applications whose final effective action is Alert
AlertApplicationCount.description_zh: 最终生效动作为Alert（观察）的内置应用数量

AllowApplicationCount.description_en: The number of built-in applications whose final effective action is Allow
AllowApplicationCount.description_zh: 最终生效动作为Allow（放行）的内置应用数量

DenyApplicationCount.description_en: The number of built-in applications whose final effective action is Deny
DenyApplicationCount.description_zh: 最终生效动作为Deny（拦截）的内置应用数量

BuiltInApplicationStatus.description_en:
The switch status of built-in application control. Valid values:
Enable: enabled
Disable: disabled
BuiltInApplicationStatus.description_zh:
内置应用管控开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the application template. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 应用程序模板的创建时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

CustomRuleCount.description_en: The number of custom application rules under the template
CustomRuleCount.description_zh: 模板下的应用程序自定义规则数量

CustomRuleStatus.description_en:
The switch status of custom application rules. Valid values:
Enable: enabled
Disable: disabled
CustomRuleStatus.description_zh:
应用程序自定义规则开关状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭

Description.description_en: The description of the application template
Description.description_zh: 应用程序模板的描述信息

TemplateStatus.description_en:
The master switch status of the application template. Valid values:
Enable: enabled
Disable: disabled

应用程序模板总开关状态。取值：

Disable：关闭

The action for unrecognized applications. Valid values:
Allow: allow

未识别应用的处置动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截

UpdateTime.description_en: The last modification time of the application template. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 应用程序模板的最近修改时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of application templates that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的应用程序模板总数
